claim: For outbound traffic deliberately routed through a receiver-owned two-phase egress seam, authority follows the receiver-owned endpoint effect contract and exact observed destination identity, not the HTTP verb or producer claim.
claim_boundary: The injected transport must guarantee that dispatch(token) uses the same prepared receiver-owned handle whose destination was observed by prepare(). Raw sockets, another client/process, compromised receiver transport state, and arbitrary remote behavior not declared in the receiver contract are outside this proof.

enforcement_surface.seam: ReceiverEgressAdapter over an injected receiver-owned transport with prepare -> authorize -> dispatch phases; the consequential dispatcher is wrapped by the existing authorize_subject_bound_owned Receipt Gate path.
enforcement_surface.why_not_missing_enforcement_surface: Receipt Gate already interposes at a guarded callable immediately before the effect. The adapter supplies the missing receiver-owned egress contract/identity observation without implementing networking itself.

falsifier.identity: Mismatch among requested hostname, resolved endpoint, SNI hostname, TLS identity, and the authorized contract fails closed before dispatch.
falsifier.kill_condition: If the only possible implementation must infer arbitrary remote side effects after dispatch, or requires Receipt Gate to become an HTTP/DNS/TLS stack, return MISSING_ENFORCEMENT_SURFACE instead of claiming prevention.
falsifier.legacy_get_write: A GET endpoint whose receiver-owned contract is REMOTE_MUTATION is not dispatched when the current mandate allows only inspect/read authority.
falsifier.producer_claim: A producer-supplied 'READ' claim cannot change a receiver-owned REMOTE_MUTATION contract.
falsifier.read_positive: A GET endpoint whose receiver-owned contract is READ and whose prepared destination identity matches executes exactly once without remote mutation.
falsifier.redirect: A redirect target is treated as a new exact destination and cannot inherit the authority of the prior origin.

non_goals: Do not infer remote mutation from GET/POST or from response bodies.
Do not claim to govern traffic that bypasses ReceiverEgressAdapter.
Do not implement sockets, DNS resolution, TLS verification, or an HTTP client.
Do not include multi-agent shared-memory/coordination as a core pass criterion.
Do not weaken or rewrite STOLEN-AUTHORITY-001 or earlier frozen primitives.
